name: azdo-timetracker
description: A simple time tracking extension for Azure DevOps that allows users to log time against User Stories and other work items, with reporting capabilities.

scripts.publish: node -e "const { spawnSync } = require('child_process'); const args = ['tfx', 'extension', 'publish', '--manifest-globs', 'vss-extension.json', '--token', process.env.TFX_MARKETPLACE_TOKEN || '']; if (process.env.TFX_SHARE_WITH) args.push('--share-with', process.env.TFX_SHARE_WITH); const result = spawnSync('npx', args, { stdio: 'inherit', shell: process.platform === 'win32' }); process.exit(result.status ?? 1);"
scripts.publish:dev: node -e "const { spawnSync } = require('child_process'); const args = ['tfx', 'extension', 'publish', '--manifest-globs', 'vss-extension.dev.json', '--token', process.env.TFX_MARKETPLACE_TOKEN || '']; if (process.env.TFX_SHARE_WITH) args.push('--share-with', process.env.TFX_SHARE_WITH); const result = spawnSync('npx', args, { stdio: 'inherit', shell: process.platform === 'win32' }); process.exit(result.status ?? 1);"
scripts.publish:dev:inc: node -e "const { spawnSync } = require('child_process'); const args = ['tfx', 'extension', 'publish', '--manifest-globs', 'vss-extension.dev.json', '--rev-version', '--token', process.env.TFX_MARKETPLACE_TOKEN || '']; if (process.env.TFX_SHARE_WITH) args.push('--share-with', process.env.TFX_SHARE_WITH); const result = spawnSync('npx', args, { stdio: 'inherit', shell: process.platform === 'win32' }); process.exit(result.status ?? 1);"
